notes.title: Robbery Bob Now Available!
notes.content:
Robbery Bob: Man of Steal is now for sale and available to everyone on Steam!

In order to celebrate this momentous event we're offering the game at a 20% discount at launch! So stretch your arms, put on your sneakiest shoes and get looting!

Finally we'd like to thank everyone who made this possible by supporting us on Greenlight. We literally couldn't have done it without you!
